title: Fresh assurance campaigns discarded valid completed rows after coordinator interruption

source_observation.environment: 3.2.5 full no-reuse post-publication calibration from assurance commit a454159f64f392b3c4f89d2538ddbeb2f24586d7, immutable public 3.2.5 and 3.2.3 archives, Factorio 2.1.13, and the explicit 2.1 mod closure.
source_observation.fact: The coordinator was terminated by its one-hour host limit while runtime.performance-regression was active after 136 planned rows had written exact passing capsules. Freshness was bound to a process run ID and attempt, and executor planning ignored same-plan completed rows when --no-reuse was set, so a replacement coordinator would repeat them instead of carrying them forward.

reproducer.command: .\tools\mir.ps1 verify run --target 2.1 --profile full --candidate dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.5.zip --prior dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.3.zip --factorio <exact-2.1.13> --mods C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods\2.1 --no-reuse --plan build\results\terminal-calibration\3.2.5-0026-ecosystem-plan.json
reproducer.expected: A durable plan owns fresh campaign identity. A resumed exact plan adopts only completed matching campaign rows and runs only the remaining rows; a planned time budget stops only between rows and reports checkpointed rather than passing.
reproducer.observed: The process ended at the host boundary with a stale performance running marker and no aggregate. Existing passing capsules could satisfy neither the no-reuse executor nor an aggregate tied to a replacement host run.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; verifier campaign coordination and evidence custody only

regression_obligations: fresh plan materializes an immutable campaign ID and each fresh row binds that campaign plus minimum completion time
